entries.name: GEM_LOGIC_API_KEY
entries.description: A Gem Logic API key made for KaratOS. Gem Logic keys can't be limited, so KaratOS sends it only with GET requests for sales channels and products. It goes only to the business's Gem Logic instance.
howToGet: Signed in to Gem Logic as an admin, open Settings > API and create a key named KaratOS.
Copy the key straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.
To cut KaratOS off, deactivate or delete the key on the same page.

entries.name: GEM_LOGIC_INSTANCE
entries.description: The business's Gem Logic instance: example in example.gem-logic.com.
howToGet: Copy it from the browser's address bar while signed in to Gem Logic.
